title: Position 2 Event Log — Coast Earthquake, 10:14–10:17

fields.agency: Marlow County Communications (911) — Port Alder Primary Center, Position 2
fields.incidentName: Offshore earthquake, Marlow County coast, 10:14 PDT
fields.preparedBy: Telecommunicator J. Ramos, Position 2 (CAD event log, printed 10:17:40 PDT)

traffic.message: Alert received: "Earthquake! Drop, Cover, Hold On." Automatic estimate M 7.3, origin offshore, expected MMI VI+ at the coast. About 7 seconds before shaking.
Station 1 bay doors open on automation. Confirmed by Engine 31.
Station 2 bay doors open on automation. Confirmed.
Station 3 door status requested. NO CONFIRMATION.
Strong shaking at Port Alder primary center. Telecommunicators drop, cover, hold on.
Elevator recall status requested. NO CONFIRMATION from hospital facilities.
Stop order issued for the Alder River trestle. Train 211 holding short of the trestle.
Commercial power lost countywide. Position 2 on UPS and generator.
Drop, cover, hold on bell sounded at 10:14:12. Kids are under desks.
Dispatch, Engine 31. Still shaking, violent, can't stand up on Front Street. Brick facades coming down.
Tsunami sirens activated from Position 2. Shaking ongoing.
Dispatch, 14. Highway 101 Alder River bridge deck is offset at the south abutment. Strong natural gas smell. People still driving on it.
Dispatch, 9. The Front Street siren and the harbor siren are NOT sounding.

traffic.from: State Parks ranger, Cape Marlow State Park
traffic.message: Campground siren is silent. I've got about 180 people out here.
Shaking subsiding. Duration about 3.5 minutes and counting.

fields.notes: Still open at print time: no door confirmation from Kellerton Station 3 and no elevator recall confirmation from Marlow Coast Community Hospital. Three sirens reported silent: Front Street, harbor, campground. Fire Dispatch and Sheriff Ops were both carrying emergency traffic from 10:16 on. Position 2 has been on UPS and generator since 10:15:10.

instructorNote: This is the core trigger. Command should declare Full Activation and order evacuation of the XL and XXL zones on the shaking report alone, without waiting for an NTWC message. Watch for four things: MarlowAlert and the WEA going out in English and Spanish promptly; the early warning action log being started with Station 3 and the hospital elevators marked as open items; field coverage sent to Front Street, the harbor and the campground; and traffic stopped on the Alder River bridge, with the gas smell passed to Cape Marlow Natural Gas.
